# test262 sample

A deterministic 1-in-25 sample of the policy-eligible `test/language` tests from
[tc39/test262](https://github.com/tc39/test262) at commit `419d3e0a` (BSD-3, see LICENSE), plus the harness.
Regenerate with `npm run test262:fetch && npm run test262:sample`. 653 of 16323 eligible tests.
